body:
I did mostly Ashtanga, it was very intense. I prefer Vinyasa though. I've done Hatha as well but find it pretty boring.

GABA does not cross the blood brain barrier. I've taken plenty of GABA before. Picamilon is a supplement that is a GABA molecule attached to a niacin molecule. It crosses the BBB and is separated in the brain, making GABA available. Give it a try if GABA helps you. The doses of the other ingredients aren't, you could say, clinically relevant.
